done_when: The worker brief says a recorded choice is needed only after close has stopped the review loop and otherwise the worker fixes the findings in that round; new repos get it at init and existing repos on sync, with one command test

findings.body: Raise: Not done — an existing repo upgraded between worker rounds can keep waiting for a choice that close will not record. The ruling that resumed rounds inherit the clarification assumes their earlier brief already contained it. In an active session started before this change, it did not. On resume, `src/forge/worker.py:423-428` sends “The earlier brief in this conversation still applies” and the old review-loop instruction, but never reads these new template lines. The command test starts its worker only after sync, so it does not cover this upgrade path.
findings.title: Not done: Active worker sessions miss the brief update after sync

why: Workers sit idle waiting for a choice Forge refuses to record: after a recorded narrow, a worker treats every new finding as needing a fresh choice, but a choice can only be recorded once close stops the loop
